critical_code_review_comments: seed_phase2.py — idempotency guards are correct per-collection: alumni by (institution_id,email), pubs by (institution_id,title), drives by (institution_id,company,role,scheduled_date), energy by (institution_id,meter_id,period). Verified survives backend restart with no duplicates inserted.

routes_exec.py — composite_score formula has a hard +15 baseline plus a 100 cap; this means even minimal data scores ≥75 (always A+/A++), reducing differentiation across tenants. Consider tying baseline to actual configured-active modules or audit completeness for more discriminating output. Not a functional bug.
routes_exec.py — _guard correctly allows super_admin override and same-tenant access; 403 on cross-tenant verified for ISB target with VCE principal.

routes_exec.py — Inlines summary aggregation rather than reusing existing /summary endpoints despite docstring claim of 'reuses the existing summary endpoints'. Mildly contradicts comment but logic is consistent with COMPASS AQAR formula used elsewhere.

Onboarding.jsx launch() — correctly diffs current vs selected and PATCHes only changed codes, minimising API calls. No-op launch (no changes) still advances to step 3 with a success toast which is acceptable UX.

Onboarding.jsx — does NOT enforce module dependencies declared in catalog (e.g., depends_on shown only as informational text). User can disable VEDA while keeping dependents active; this is acceptable since /modules/{vce}/{code} PATCH endpoint is the authoritative validator, but consider client-side warnings.
